While participating in courses within the LEAP program, one hears often about the increasing disrespect of Human Rights. To my knowledge, the (CIRIGHTS dataset)\[https://cirights.com\] is likely the most comprehensive, at least untill (ICMD)\[https://icmd.se\] will be available.

Below a simple boxplot of the

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
df <- read.csv("database.csv")

library(dplyr)

# Select columns 8 to 26 and Year column
col_indices <- 9:15
target_cols <- names(df)[col_indices]
print(paste("Processing columns:", paste(target_cols, collapse = ", ")))

# Filter function: only use values 0,1,2 (omit others/NA)
mean_filtered <- function(x) {
  valid_vals <- x[x %in% c(0, 1, 2)]
  if(length(valid_vals) > 0) mean(valid_vals) else NA
}

# Calculate mean for each column by Year, using only 0,1,2 values
means_by_year <- df %>%
  select(year, all_of(target_cols)) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(target_cols), mean_filtered, .names = "mean_{.col}")) %>%
  ungroup()

# View results
#print(means_by_year)

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# Reshape to long format
means_long <- means_by_year %>%
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Mean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Mean))

# Fix: Dynamically create scales for EXACT number of variables
n_vars <- length(unique(means_long$Variable))
line_types <- c(rep("solid", ceiling(n_vars/2)), rep("dashed", floor(n_vars/2)))


library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# Split 42 variables into groups of 12 panels each
var_list <- unique(means_long$Variable)
n_groups <- ceiling(length(var_list) / 12)  # ~4 plots

# Create plots for each group
plot_list <- list()
for(i in 1:n_groups) {
  vars_subset <- var_list[((i-1)*12 + 1):min(i*12, length(var_list))]
  p <- ggplot(means_long %>% filter(Variable %in% vars_subset), 
              aes(x = year, y = Mean, group = 1)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, color = "steelblue") +
    facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4, nrow = 3) +
    labs(title = paste("Mean Values by Year - Group", i, "(Vars", min(vars_subset), "-", max(vars_subset), ")")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}

# Combine into single object or save separately
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 1)  # Stack vertically
print(combined_plot)



```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)


# Add column with mean of ALL variables for each year (at the end)
means_by_year <- means_by_year %>%
  mutate(Overall_Mean = rowMeans(select(., -year), na.rm = TRUE))

# View result
print(means_by_year)


col_indices <- 8:13
target_cols <- names(df)[col_indices]

# CORRECTED: Filter using dplyr (handles dimensions properly)
df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(target_cols), ~ .x %in% c(0, 1, 2, NA_real_, NA)))

# Reshape to long format
df_long <- df_filtered %>%
  select(year, all_of(target_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  filter(Value %in% c(0, 1, 2) & !is.na(Value))

# Boxplot: all individual values per year
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = factor(year), y = Value, fill = Variable)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9, padding = 0.1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Boxplots of Individual Values (0,1,2 only) by Year",
       subtitle = "Columns 8-26 | Position-dodged for multiple variables",
       x = "Year", y = "Value", fill = "Variable") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
